topic: Overnighter vs multi-week trip: what changes in planning

content.hook: POV: your overnighter plan meets week three

scenes.text: POV: your *overnighter* plan meets week three
Overnighter: distance is enough. Longer trips need *realistic riding days*
Multi-week: plan *water, food and repair* along the way

content.caption:
POV: your overnighter plan meets week three. Bikepacking trip planning changes with trip length.

Overnighter: one forecast, an easy way home, and you carry what you already know works.

Multi-week: conditions change along the way, so plan in segments. Think realistic riding days (not just kilometres), rest days, and where you can resupply water, food and bike repair.

Short trip = pack and go. Long trip = plan the stretches in between.

Overnighter or multi-week: which are you planning?
